summary: Google is likely already the largest AI traffic destination globally when including Search AI Overviews, and is the leading AI company today.
summary_extended: Baker argues that Google (GOOGL) is likely already the largest AI traffic destination in the world when combining Gemini's standalone usage with Search AI Overviews, and that the market underappreciates Google's current AI leadership position. He estimates Gemini alone has taken 15-20 points of traffic share in the last 2-3 months, and suspects Google's aggregate AI traffic exceeds that of OpenAI, Anthropic, and all other competitors combined. Baker frames ChatGPT's rise as a 'Pearl Harbor moment' for Google that has now catalyzed a forceful response, with Gemini running on Google's proprietary TPUs reinforcing a structural vertical integration advantage in cost and performance. The investment implication is that GOOGL is a buy or strong hold as the leading AI company today, with the contrarian view being that consensus has underestimated Google's competitive position in the AI race relative to pure-play AI challengers.
